subject: Security intake & ID/access evidence — POC next steps

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>

Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Security intake & ID/access evidence — POC next steps

Hi Sarah — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep the POC on the 4-week timeline you mentioned: 

1) What we heard from you:
   - POC to validate SAML SSO with your Okta tenant, and SCIM for user & team sync.
   - Procurement wants a filled vendor security questionnaire and confirmation on SOC 2 / HIPAA posture.
   - RBAC: a 2-3 admin role separation (Org Admin, Billing Admin, Support Admin) + audit logging are required.

2) Our immediate asks from your side to unblock engineering:
   - IdP metadata (SAML 2.0) or SAML test connector values (EntityID, ACS URL).
   - SCIM endpoint expectations: do you require immediate push provisioning or periodic sync?
   - Any must-have RBAC mappings to mirror on the Redwood side for the POC.

3) What we attached for you:
   - Medisys_Vendor_Q_v1.pdf (vendor questionnaire stub — please complete where applicable)
   - Redwood_SSO_Metadata.xml (SP metadata we can consume)

Next steps: if you can return the completed questionnaire and IdP metadata by EOD next Wednesday we can schedule the SAML test on our staging cluster the following week. I'll loop Rishi (solutions) and Monica (security/implementation) for technical details.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0134

- We attached Medisys_Vendor_Q_v1.pdf with some initial answers and open items (see attached).

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lawson <sarah.lawson@medisys.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2026 09:08:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake & ID/access evidence — POC next steps

Thanks Sarah — answers inline and attachments below.

- SOC 2 / HIPAA: Redwood currently holds SOC 2 Type I documentation and is targeting SOC 2 Type II completion in Q3 2026; we can run the POC before Type II completes. We can discuss a BAA — we do offer BAA for Private/Dedicated deployments; happy to have legal follow up once procurement confirms the deployment preference.

- SAML support: We support both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated SAML 2.0 flows. SLO is supported but rarely required for POC.

- RBAC and audit logs: sample role mappings and an audit-retention summary are attached. We retain audit logs for 12 months by default on Hosted, and retention can be extended for Dedicated/Private deployments.

Attachments included in this message:
- Redwood_SSO_Metadata.xml (SP metadata - for your IdP team)
- Redwood_SCIM_Instructions.docx (SCIM endpoints and capabilities, provisioning modes)

Estimated engineering turnaround: once we have completed questionnaire + IdP metadata, typical SAML setup + validation on staging is 2-3 business days; SCIM provisioning test can be done in parallel but may need an additional day to validate group mapping.

Proposed next meeting: TBD next Tue 10:00am PT to walk through the questionnaire items and SAML metadata exchange. Does that time work?

Cheers,
Neha

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2026 11:27:12 -0700
Subject: RE: Security intake & ID/access evidence — POC next steps

Neha / Rishi — technical notes for the Medisys IdP team before the sync: 

- SP metadata details (attached Redwood_SP_Metadata.xml) include ACS URL, EntityID, certificate thumbprint. Please confirm we should use redirect binding for SSO.
- SCIM: we implement SCIM 2.0 (PATCH, PUT) and support incremental sync; no heavy bulk import. Group mapping: we map SCIM groups to Redwood teams; if Medisys has nested groups please flag.
- RBAC: we can provide the following roles for the POC: Organization Owner, Team Admin, Support Operator, Read-only Auditor. We will provide a CSV example of role-to-permission mappings on request.
- Audit logs: default 12 months; for Dedicated/Private we can configure longer retention and export hooks to S3 or your SIEM.

Attaching: Redwood_SP_Metadata.xml

-Monica

If you can drop the short admin controls PDF and confirm audit log granularity by EOD Mon we can keep the POC start the week after next.
